questions.title: Two masses on a string (double pendulum)
questions.summary: Same set-up as VJC Q1 starting from x ≈ 15 cm: vary the upper string length x and test T⁴ = Px + Q.

xlsx.desc: x and 10-oscillation timings for seven lengths; plot T⁴ against x.

questions.title: Rubber bands and a capacitor-discharge dataset
questions.summary: As SAJC Q2: with b fixed, sin α = Cm and C = g/(2ek). Then analyse a datalogger record of a 2200 µF capacitor discharging from 6.0 V: τ from ln I against t, and the charge from the area under the I–t graph.

xlsx.desc: A practice version of capacitorDischarge.csv: I every 0.5 s. Plot ln I against t for τ; trapezium sum for Q.

questions.title: Resistance of a coil of wire
questions.summary: Same apparatus as VJC Q3: estimate the wire length on each tube, find each coil's resistance from IR = GR + H (X = H/G), compare with X = kL/d², and reason about which coil gives the stronger field at its ends.

xlsx.desc: I against R for coils Y and Z; plot IR against R.
